qualifications_or_emphasis: The Board's response to the observations of Secretarial Auditors made are given in the Directors' Report.

The composition of the Board of Directors of the Company was temporarily not in conformity with the requirements of Regulation 17(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, for the period from August 15, 2025 to March 16, 2026, consequent upon the resignation of a Woman Independent Director. However, it is noted that the Company has since rectified the said non-compliance with effect from March 17, 2026, upon the appointment of a suitable Woman Independent Director.

During the period from August 15, 2025 till March 16, 2026, the composition of the Board of Directors of the Company, in terms of Regulation 17 (1) of SEBI LODR, was temporarily imbalanced due to the resignation of an Independent Woman Director. The recognized Stock Exchanges viz. BSE Ltd & National Stock Exchange of India Ltd., each, have levied fine of INR. 7,13,900/- (inclusive of GST) which was duly remitted by the Company within the prescribed time.
